const store = this.getWorkflowStaticData('global');
if (!store.blacklist) store.blacklist = {};

const http = async (o) => await this.helpers.httpRequest(Object.assign({ timeout: 30000 }, o));

const BOT = '8366696724:AAHROcjGoQEn9BziD-sYdAu3ZuaolwtkgLE';
const CHAT = '523002062';
const NL = String.fromCharCode(10);

async function notify(text) {
  try {
    await http({
      method: 'POST',
      url: 'https://api.telegram.org/bot' + BOT + '/sendMessage',
      json: true,
      body: { chat_id: CHAT, text },
    });
  } catch (e) {}
}

const prev = {
  riskCodes: Array.isArray(store.blacklist?.riskCodes) ? store.blacklist.riskCodes.slice() : null,
  riskUpdatedAt: store.blacklist?.riskUpdatedAt || null,
};

try {

const KRX_URL = 'https://data.krx.co.kr/comm/bldAttendant/getJsonData.cmd';
const BASE_UA = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));

// ===== 세션 쿠키 사전 획득 =====
// KRX 서버는 브라우저 세션 없이 자동화 요청을 차단함
// GET으로 메인 페이지를 먼저 방문해 쿠키를 획득한 뒤 POST에 포함
let sessionCookie = '';
try {
  const sessionRes = await http({
    method: 'GET',
    url: 'https://data.krx.co.kr/contents/MDC/MDI/mdiLoader/index.cmd?menuId=MDC02021201',
    headers: {
      'User-Agent': BASE_UA,
      'Accept': 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8',
      'Accept-Language': 'ko-KR,ko;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7',
      'Accept-Encoding': 'gzip, deflate, br',
      'Connection': 'keep-alive',
      'Upgrade-Insecure-Requests': '1',
    },
    returnFullResponse: true,
  });
  const setCookie = sessionRes?.headers?.['set-cookie'];
  if (setCookie) {
    const cookies = Array.isArray(setCookie) ? setCookie : [setCookie];
    // returnFullResponse 결과의 set-cookie 배열에 undefined 요소가 포함될 수 있어 타입 가드 필요
    sessionCookie = cookies
      .filter(c => typeof c === 'string' && c.length > 0)
      .map(c => c.split(';')[0])
      .join('; ');
  }
  store.blacklist._sessionAt = new Date().toISOString();
} catch (e) {
  store.blacklist._sessionErr = String(e?.message || e);
}

const KRX_HEADERS = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
  'Accept': 'application/json, text/javascript, */*; q=0.01',
  'Accept-Language': 'ko-KR,ko;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7',
  'Accept-Encoding': 'gzip, deflate, br',
  'Origin': 'https://data.krx.co.kr',
  'Referer': 'https://data.krx.co.kr/contents/MDC/MDI/mdiLoader/index.cmd?menuId=MDC02021201',
  'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
  'User-Agent': BASE_UA,
  'Connection': 'keep-alive',
  ...(sessionCookie ? { 'Cookie': sessionCookie } : {}),
};

const KRX_BLDS = [
  'dbms/MDC/STAT/issue/MDCSTAT21201', // 거래정지
  'dbms/MDC/STAT/issue/MDCSTAT21401', // 관리종목
  'dbms/MDC/STAT/issue/MDCSTAT21701', // 투자주의환기(코)
  'dbms/MDC/STAT/issue/MDCSTAT23701', // 정리매매
  'dbms/MDC/STAT/issue/MDCSTAT22801', // 투자주의
  'dbms/MDC/STAT/issue/MDCSTAT23101', // 투자경고
  'dbms/MDC/STAT/issue/MDCSTAT23401', // 투자위험
];

// ===== 재시도 포함 KRX 요청 =====
// 일시적 차단 시 최대 3회, 2초 간격으로 재시도
async function fetchKrxCodesWithRetry(bld, maxRetry = 3) {
  const body = `bld=${encodeURIComponent(bld)}&locale=ko_KR&mktId=ALL&csvxls_isNo=true`;
  let lastErr = null;

  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxRetry; attempt++) {
    try {
      const res = await http({
        method: 'POST',
        url: KRX_URL,
        headers: KRX_HEADERS,
        body,
        json: true,
      });
      const rows = (res && (res.output || res.OutBlock_1 || [])) || [];
      const codes = [];
      for (const r of rows) {
        const c = String(r?.ISU_CD || '').trim();
        if (/^\d{6}$/.test(c)) codes.push(c);
      }
      return codes;
    } catch (e) {
      lastErr = e;
      const status = e?.statusCode ?? e?.response?.statusCode ?? e?.cause?.statusCode ?? '?';
      store.blacklist._lastRetryErr = `attempt${attempt} bld=${bld.split('/').pop()} status=${status} msg=${String(e?.message || e).slice(0, 120)}`;
      if (attempt < maxRetry) await sleep(2000 * attempt);
    }
  }
  throw lastErr;
}

// KIND 실질심사법인: HTML 테이블 파싱
async function fetchKindRealInvestigationCodes() {
  const url = 'https://kind.krx.co.kr/corpgeneral/delistRealInvstg.do';
  const form = {
    method: 'searchDelistRealInvstg',
    forward: 'delistRealInvstg_down',
    pageIndex: '1',
    currentPageSize: '3000',
    mktTpCd: '',
    progrsDelistYn: '',
    fromDate: '',
    toDate: '',
  };
  const body = Object.entries(form)
    .map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(v)}`)
    .join('&');

  const raw = await http({
    method: 'POST',
    url,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
      'Origin': 'https://kind.krx.co.kr',
      'Referer': 'https://kind.krx.co.kr/corpgeneral/delistRealInvstg.do?method=searchDelistRealInvstgMain',
      'User-Agent': BASE_UA,
    },
    body,
    json: false,
  });

  const text = Buffer.isBuffer(raw) ? raw.toString('latin1') : String(raw);
  const set = new Set();
  for (const m of text.matchAll(/mso-number-format:'@'[^>]*>\s*(\d{6})\s*<\/td>/g)) {
    set.add(m[1]);
  }
  return [...set];
}

const codes = new Set();
const sourceCounts = {};

for (const bld of KRX_BLDS) {
  const list = await fetchKrxCodesWithRetry(bld);
  sourceCounts[bld] = list.length;
  for (const c of list) codes.add(c);
}

const kindCodes = await fetchKindRealInvestigationCodes();
sourceCounts['KIND:realInvestigation'] = kindCodes.length;
for (const c of kindCodes) codes.add(c);

store.blacklist.riskCodes = [...codes].sort();
store.blacklist.riskUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
store.blacklist.riskSourceCounts = sourceCounts;
store.blacklist._sessionCookieLen = sessionCookie.length;

return [
  {
    json: {
      ok: true,
      riskCodesCount: store.blacklist.riskCodes.length,
      riskSourceCounts: sourceCounts,
      riskUpdatedAt: store.blacklist.riskUpdatedAt,
      sessionCookieObtained: sessionCookie.length > 0,
    },
  },
];

} catch (e) {
  const msg = e?.message ? String(e.message) : String(e);
  const status = e?.statusCode ?? e?.response?.statusCode ?? e?.cause?.statusCode ?? null;
  const errDetail = status ? `HTTP ${status}: ${msg}` : msg;

  store.blacklist.riskLastError = {
    at: new Date().toISOString(),
    message: errDetail,
    status,
    sessionCookieLen: sessionCookie ? sessionCookie.length : 0,
  };

  if (prev.riskCodes) store.blacklist.riskCodes = prev.riskCodes;
  if (prev.riskUpdatedAt) store.blacklist.riskUpdatedAt = prev.riskUpdatedAt;

  await notify('🚨 [리스크 블랙리스트 갱신 실패]' + NL + errDetail + NL + `(캐시: ${store.blacklist.riskUpdatedAt || '없음'})`);
  return [{ json: { ok: false, error: errDetail, status, riskUpdatedAt: store.blacklist.riskUpdatedAt || null } }];
}
